messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert created by perf-watcher: gen-service p95 latency jumped from 420ms -> 2.4s over last 5m. Error rate on streaming connections up 6% and connection churn increased.
alex: acked. paging in. I'm oncall. grabbing logs now.
maya: on it — seeing a lot of stalled connections in the streaming workers, KV cache pressure looks high. Possibly head-of-line blocking from large chunked responses.
lia: product note — disabling streaming will change UX for chat customers (responses will arrive as single final payload instead of chunks). We need to assess which customers are on streaming and call out if any enterprise SLA expects stream semantics.
alex: understood. immediate goal: stabilize tail latencies and throughput. proposing two-step live mitigation: 1) apply short-term global rate cap on streaming endpoints; 2) if that doesn't drop p95 quickly, flip streaming -> non-streaming (sse/gzip off) for public hosted tier for 15-60m.
maya: agree. we can flip a feature flag to suppress chunked sends and fall back to single-response path. I've got the flag path.
alex: @deploy-bot — prepare quick toggle for ff:redwood.streaming.push_enabled -> false for hosted-production. keep dedicated/private untouched.
deploy-bot: Received toggle request. Preparing rollout. Will route change through config service with canary 5% -> 100% if stable.
ops-monitor: quick snapshot from traces: 1836007600 - 1836007700 CPU on stream-workers 92%, queue latency spikes on grpc-server at 800-1200ms. After we flip, monitor for request-fanning (clients polling).
maya: executing flag toggle (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://config.redwood.internal/v1/flags/toggle 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' 
 -d '{"flag":"redwood.streaming.push_enabled","env":"prod","value":false,"note":"temp mitigate p95 spike"}'
```
alex: doing traffic routing changes too: raising per-connection request deadline from 30s -> 45s to reduce premature client retries.
deploy-bot: Flag change applied to 5% canary at 1836007832 :white_check_mark:. Starting health checks for 5 minutes.
ops-monitor: CANARY metrics: p95 reduced by ~350ms in canary group, streaming error rate fell from 5.7% -> 1.2%. queue depth down 28%.
deploy-bot: Rolling to 100% at 1836008055 :white_check_mark:.
alex: observed system-wide p95 drop from 2.4s -> 730ms within 3m of full roll. throughput recovered ~14%.
maya: leaving additional guard — applying a short-term token-bucket rate limiter on streaming endpoints per-account: 20 requests/min burst 5 to avoid sudden replays. Patch applied.
ops-bot: Quota update: increased short-term burst quota for non-stream generation (synchronous endpoint) to compensate for expected client switchovers. Notified rate-limiter service.
chloe: CS heads notified. Drafted short blurb for status page: "We are temporarily suspending streaming chunked responses for hosted API to stabilize latency. Most requests will receive a single final response. No data loss. We expect full streaming restore after traffic shape testing."
lia: thanks Chloe — please include a note for customers using SSE and websocket clients to handle single-message responses for the window.
sre-lead: good mitigation. keep this thread for timeline. action items: 1) postmortem owner? 2) plan rollback criteria and perf test matrix to validate enabling streaming again (small ramp with sampling).
alex: I'll own the postmortem. immediate status: mitigation in place, customers notified, monitoring dashboards updated. continuing to watch for retry storms. will update 15m. :thumbsup:
maya: adding follow-up tasks: run targeted perf job with large-chunk responses to reproduce head-of-line, quantify KV cache thresholds, and test alternate chunking strategy (smaller chunks).
ops-monitor: observed last_message at 1836009577: p95 stable ~680ms for 15m, streaming error rate under 1%.
sre-lead: thanks team — if metrics remain stable at next checkpoint (30m) we can shift to throttled re-enable with sampling. Document the exact CLI toggle commands and roll steps in the postmortem.
alex: closing incident handoff to postmortem. leaving open for 1hr watch. :white_check_mark:
